free_tier.stated: 1 GB per account for citizen-uploaded documents (was 100 MB at launch).

egress.terms: not applicable — documents are private to the account holder and to requesting agencies via consent; there is no public/anonymous retrieval URL. That alone disqualifies it as a serving or archive tier.

interface_detail: No public upload API. Partner agencies integrate via DigiLocker APIs; individuals use the app/web UI only.
tooling: none for bulk; UI-only for citizens.
chaining: none — private namespace, consent-gated sharing, no direct link model.
limits_note: per-object-cap 10 MB/file, per-account 1 GB. identity_cost is the hard stop: Aadhaar number + OTP to the Aadhaar-linked Indian mobile. A non-resident without an Aadhaar-linked +91 number cannot register at all.
reliability_note: ISO 27001 state service, very reliable, but 1 GB total and no public URLs mean it fails two of the four filters simultaneously.

evidence.proved: 'It also provides 1 GB storage space to each account to upload scanned copies of legacy documents'; 'Users need to possess an Aadhaar number... identity is verified using a one-time password (OTP) sent to the linked mobile number'; 'Individual files are limited to 10 MB.'
